verdict.rationale: Poke is a consumer AI assistant, so a control over whether conversations are used for model training is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions training-data use, an opt-out setting, or a data-retention policy. The integration disconnect, account merging and memory items are about other features and do not address model training.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
